g.text: An evaluation harness, end to end
Three connected lanes. Read each lane left to right; cross-links carry evidence and learning.
OFFLINE · O1–O5 · controlled cases, before or after release
Controlled tests may call a hosted API.
Freeze cases, versions, environment and clock.
SHARED EVIDENCE · capture, store and correlate
Use the version in force at event time.
Registry informs retrieval and freshness checks.
ONLINE · P1–P5 · production traffic and outcomes
Review, redact, add confirmed regression cases
O / T / P are separate lanes, not one timeline. D1 is a shared reference; it does not execute refunds.
Conceptual architecture. Local POC uses authored fixtures; live A/B, trace storage and online integrations are not installed.
